title: acre reference leaves containers out of what a container holds
body: `acre reference` ends each container's entry with a `holds` line. For `group`, `stack`, `grid` and `panel` that line stops at `ruler`, and leaves out `group`, `stack`, `grid`, `panel` and `repeat`. acre accepts a stack inside a stack and a group inside a group, so the line is wrong. A reader of the reference concludes that containers do not nest and lays a figure out flat.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/0c799e42
notes.text: The reported bug did not reproduce on dev at 8d5c911: every container's holds line already lists group, stack, grid, panel and repeat, since DRAWN carried them from the commit that added repeat. Added a test in scene/build.rs that builds a canvas per container and drawn kind and checks the builder accepts it exactly when listed, and made the unknown-node error read the canvas list from the schema. Commit a6b5a48.
